tools.description: Read one page of a job's per-row results. Readable while the job is still running. Pass cursor back as the next cursor until next_cursor is null. Does not spend credits and does not change the job.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: verify_email, find_emails_bulk · Private data: create_job · Public sink: find_email, verify_email · Destructive: find_email, verify_email, find_emails_bulk.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: verify_email, find_emails_bulk · Private data: create_job · Public sink: find_email, verify_email · Destructive: find_email, verify_email, find_emails_bulk

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
